query.description: The task submitted for this turn.

data.description: The turn's result, same shape as the top-level `data`.

actions.description: Every tool call this turn made, appended as each finishes; seq gives call order.

units.description: Units derived from the model tokens this turn consumed. Informational only: runs are billed for browser time.

replayError.description: Present only when `replay: true` was requested and the run couldn't provision a recordable session for this turn.

replayId.description: Present when `replay: true` was requested and the recording was saved. Open it at `/account/session-replay/player?id=<replayId>`.
